description: Returns comments on a specific Boardroom todo or idea, oldest first by default. agent_id required. Reading the same thread repeatedly? Pass 'since' (the created_at of the newest comment you already hold) and 'since_id' (its id) to receive only what landed after it, and 'order': 'newest' to read from the end. The answer then carries a 'cursor' block: newest_created_at and newest_id (feed them back next time) and door_page_full (true when the thread has reached the door's 200-row page cap, so comments past the cap are not visible here; continue on a new chip).

order.description: 'oldest' is the door's own page order and the only order a forward cursor (since) uses, so polling never skips a row. 'newest' is a tail read: the most recent comments first, without since.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, inclusive at the door's microsecond precision. Comments created at or after this instant are returned; pass since_id to drop the one you already hold at that instant. Use the created_at of the newest comment you have read.

since_id.description: The id of the comment you already hold at the 'since' instant. Dropped from the answer so the boundary never repeats. Needs 'since'.

name: list_comments
title: List comments on a todo or idea
